snippet.title: Books & Blood - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Books & Blood, a first-person survival horror adventure game developed by grantlerr, LowPolyFreak, and Daniel Keating. Players will explore a post-apocalyptic bookstore to retrieve books for customers, attain upgrades, and face the horrors within. Books & Blood is coming soon to PC (Steam).
